questions_before_times: What it's for: a wedding, an event, photos, a lesson or a trial
The date and the ready-by time (when everyone must be done)
Where everyone gets ready: a home, a hotel or a venue, and the town only (for the travel fee)
How many faces, and each person's role (the bride, bridesmaids, mothers, anyone under 18)
Who wants strip lashes, and any bridal hair
Whether they want a trial before the day
safety_stop: A reaction now: the face, lips or throat swelling, or trouble breathing
Makeup or lash glue in the eye with pain or a change in sight
license: A switch from the state form. Where the state's rules license makeup work, it falls under a cosmetology or esthetics license (or a makeup license where the state issues one); some states exempt makeup-only work, sometimes after a short course. Hair styling is licensed nearly everywhere.
staff_skills: ["Bridal (leads only)","Party and event makeup","Lessons","Stage and costume looks","Cover-up makeup","Bridal hair"]
messages_never: Allergies, skin conditions, past reactions, patch-test results and medical notes stay on the secure page and the artist's job link, never in a text to the customer, the owner or the staff, and never through the AI. A text says only 'a note is on the page'.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
